results.text: Employing intrinsic fluorone-dye fluorescence in a quenching-based ("on-off") strategy for diltiazem determination in tablets and capsules. Drug-drug interaction between diltiazem and tacrolimus in relation to CYP3A5 genotype status in Chinese pediatric patients with nephrotic range proteinuria: a retrospective study. Tacrolimus is widely used to treat pediatric nephrotic range proteinuria (NRP). Diltiazem, a CYP3A4/5 inhibitor, is often administered with tacrolimus, affecting its pharmacokinetic profile.
